subject: complete synthetic fixed-composition candidate; not historical two-slot subject
order: serial; loads/editors three blocks, workload list empty/native/candidate at one then ten groups rotated left by trial index; updates/inputs same unrotated list

boundaries.load: Navigation start to expected complete card count/current data, hidden HA launch overlay, fonts and two animation-frame opportunities; sampled browser clock includes driver observation overhead. No compositor-presentation claim.
boundaries.cache: Fresh browser context and explicit clearBrowserCache per cold/warm pair; warm same-context reload. Service workers blocked; no HTTP routing during timing. Static transfer and actual response resources retained.
boundaries.loadCPU: Absolute document CDP counters after readiness; never subtract across navigation. Shared HA work included.
boundaries.editor: Click edit-dashboard through actual cover Tile/candidate editor plus two frame opportunities. Same-document close and reopen. Shared resource deltas and within-document CPU deltas included; empty is setup only.
boundaries.updates: Sequential REST state POSTs scheduled on Node monotonic clock; browser additional state_changed subscription verifies every delivered event and final hass state. Counts/lateness and actual elapsed duration retained. Observer adds shared diagnostic cost; no sustained workload claim.
boundaries.input: Document-capture pointerdown to watched local descriptor-journal push, using real Playwright pointer click. Empty is driver-only journal. Ten under-update activations are spaced at midpoints of ten bins in a separate update window; CPU never pooled with update-only windows.
boundaries.lifecycle: Owned listener/work diagnostics and next activation, without retained-byte attribution.

nativeMismatches: Native complete group uses five separate Tiles; candidate one card.
Native editor profile measures the cover Tile editor, not aggregate editing of all five Tiles.
Native position slider has native commit semantics; candidate uses release/Enter-only local preview.
Empty input is a driver-only button without HA service semantics.
Shared HA icon/dialog/editor costs remain in totals; no ownership or final-presentation attribution.
invalidation: Preserve slow valid and invalid attempts. Stop on unexpected capture failure; publish reason and keep affected row pending. No silent retry or replacement. Method pilots are separate files and excluded from frozen schedule.

capacity.storageExit: Guard stops owned sandbox/process group; retain evidence and reclaim only owned safe caches if necessary; otherwise stop and notify maintainer.

acceptance: Descriptive short diagnostic only. All changed-subject acceptance remains pending; historical approvals do not apply automatically; no new numerical agreement or final-MVP performance acceptance.
supersedes: Initial profile retained outside checkout. Final review found whitespace-only labels could lose accessible names; candidate now inherits defaults. Repeat the same complete diagnostic schedule for the final source; no old valid sample is replaced or pooled.
